On Wed, Mar 20, 2013 at 5:00 AM, <gso...@googlegroups.com> wrote:
  Today's Topic Summary

Group: http://groups.google.com/group/gsoc-r/topics

  • Project Idea for 2013 [2 Updates]
 Project Idea for 2013
    Muhammad Junaid Muzammil <mjunaid...@gmail.com> Mar 19 08:44PM +0500  

    Hello,
     
    I am Junaid from National University of Sciences and Technology. Currently
    I am a student of MS Electrical Engineering.
     
    *I have an idea for developing Bayesian Chain Classifier for multi
    dimensional classification. Recently, I was looking for developing an
    anomaly detector that can be used for the detection of zero day attacks
    (where rule based IDS fails). This was based over the application of
    machine learning and stochastic concepts. Due to multi dimensional nature
    of the problem, the classification of traffic (whether it falls into
    friendly or hostile class) depends upon multiple features. Hence, Bayesian
    Chain Classifier appears to be a suitable candidate for that [1].*
    *
    *
    *I haven't done much prior work over r-project. But I haven't found any
    implementation of Bayesian Chain Classifier in r-project. So the idea is to
    add support for it. *
    *
    *
    *References:*
    *[1] **J. H. Zaragoza, L. E. Sucar, E. F. Morales, C. Bielza and P.
    Larranaga, "Bayesian Chain Classifiers for Multidimensional
    Classification," Proceedings of 22nd International Joint Conference on
    Artificial Intelligence.*
     
    I would like to have feedback over this idea.
     
    Regards,
    Junaid

     

    "R. Michael Weylandt" <michael....@gmail.com> Mar 19 06:06PM  

    I quite like the sound of this, but it's nuanced enough I'd want to
    make sure you could find a good mentor.
     
    If that's not doable, is there a reference implementation of these
    algorithms you could benchmark against?
     
    MW
     
    On Tue, Mar 19, 2013 at 3:44 PM, Muhammad Junaid Muzammil
